# ankra_cost_settings (Resource)

The organisation's cloud cost pricing settings. There is one set per organisation, so declare this resource at most once. Destroying it restores the platform defaults: no discount, `eur`, no egress estimate and the default analysed-cluster limit. The counterpart of `ankra cost settings set`; it needs organisation admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cost_settings" "pricing" {
  currency                        = "eur"
  effective_discount_pct          = 12.5
  include_network_egress_estimate = true
  analysed_cluster_limit          = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `analysed_cluster_limit` (Number) How many of the costliest priced clusters the savings model analyses, 1 to 50. Unset uses the platform default (8). The platform reads back the limit in effect, so an explicit `8` cannot be told apart from the default.
- `currency` (String) Organisation display currency, lower case: `usd`, `eur`, `gbp`, `sek`, `nok`, `dkk`, `chf`, `pln`, `czk`, `jpy`, `cad`, `aud` or `inr`. Defaults to `eur`.
- `effective_discount_pct` (Number) Discount in percent applied on top of list prices, 0 to 100. Defaults to `0`.
- `include_network_egress_estimate` (Boolean) Whether a network egress estimate is included. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of the settings, `cost_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organisation has one set of cost settings; any identifier imports it.
terraform import ankra_cost_settings.pricing cost_settings
```
